mentions.name: Skewrun
mentions.description: A FOSS cybersecurity tool that resolves the Kerberos KRB_AP_ERR_SKEW (Clock Skew Too Great) error, allowing tools like Impacket or NetExec to run from a Linux attack machine whose clock is heavily desynchronized from the target Windows domain, without requiring root privileges to change the system time.
mentions.problem: Kerberos authentication fails with KRB_AP_ERR_SKEW when a Linux attack machine's clock is desynchronized from the target Windows domain, and fixing it normally requires root privileges to change system time.
mentions.source_excerpt: Skewrun -> a tool that solves the Kerberos KRB_AP_ERR_SKEW (Clock Skew Too Great) error, allowing you to run tools like Impacket or NetExec from a Linux attack machine whose clock is heavily desynchronized from the target Windows domain, without requiring root privileges to change the system time.
